title: TikTok video of 'paranormal' figure on Penarth streets sparks ghost fears
excerpt: A TikTok video filmed in Penarth shows a mysterious figure in an alley, sparking ghost and paranormal claims among frightened viewers online.
content:
A TikTok video of a mysterious figure wandering the streets of Penarth has left people fearing the town could be haunted.

Penarth may be known for its picturesque pier and seaside charm, but the Victorian town hides a spookier side, with tales of disappearing figures, mysterious apparitions and unexplained noises.

Now, a local on TikTok has captured a video of a mysterious figure stalking the streets of Penarth.

@danield0702 So last night I was parked up in penarth and everything seemed normal until I felt like something was looking at me, I looked out of my window and seen this figure holding something in it’s hand, it start walking towards my car so I quickly started my engine and started to drive but then stopped as it walked away down this alley, as I was stopped I looked down the alley and just seen it standing there for a good 30 seconds and then started to record, as I zoomed in it looks like it was pointing at me or gesturing something, then just walked off and alsmost looked see through, never have I ever been so freaked out😅#cardiff #penarth #scary #fyp ♬ Creepy and simple horror background music(1070744) - howlingindicator

Mysterious "paranormal" figure videoed in Penarth

The footage, taken in Penarth by TikTok user DanD07 , shows a shadowy figure standing in an alleyway and has sparked talk of ghosts and the paranormal.

The user said: "So last night I was parked up in Penarth and everything seemed normal until I felt like something was looking at me.

"I looked out of my window and seen this figure holding something in it's [sic] hand.

"It started walking towards my car so I quickly started my engine and started to drive but then stopped as it walked away down this alley.

"As I was stopped I looked down the alley and just seen it standing there for a good 30 seconds and then started to record.

"As I zoomed in, it looks like it was pointing at me or gesturing something, then just walked off and almost looked see through.

"Never have I ever been so freaked out."

The video has attracted plenty of attention, with some viewers saying they are now "scared to enter Penarth".

One person said: "I'm from Cardiff and now scared to enter Penarth."

Another wrote: "It looks like a girl with a smock dress and boots.

"To me it looks paranormal."

A third person said they had seen the same figure on the same street.
